Keep it away from the terminal!|audio=ContainmentWave30.ogg|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 30 ([[Containment]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Primordial Drakobloxxer''', internally just '''Drakobloxxer''', was the final boss of [[Containment]], the third Night of the [[Hexscape Event]]. It had high health, highest in the entire event, though it was also the slowest in its first phase. It emerged from the portal in a cutscene. It had seven abilities, four that could be used at any time, its second phase and two abilities it could only use after entering its second phase: #The first ability was ''Nightmare Blast''. It made '''Primordial Drakobloxxer''' scream, which formed a large death beam at the center of the map, stunning towers for 5 seconds and dealing heavy damage to units. #Its second ability was ''Enforced Departure''. It made it form a small purple orb at a part of the map, which it later teleported to, dissolving the orb. #Its third ability was ''Nightmare Storm''. It made it scream and emit purple mist, summoning two [[Unknown Boss]]es on the path. '''Primordial Drakobloxxer''' also gained the [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] attribute briefly. #Its fourth and last ability available from the first phase was ''Nightmare Storm'', which made it emit a magenta aura around it and slam the ground. This applied a 60% [[Fatigue Debuff]] to towers for 10 seconds. After losing half of its health in the Hard difficulty, '''Primordial Drakobloxxer''' would enter its second phase, making it faster by 50% and making it use its abilities more frequently. This also unlocked two additional abilities for it: #The first was ''Super Dupa Laser'', which made it create two lasers shaped like a cross that spun wildly around the map, stunning towers for 6 seconds and dealing 300 damage to units. #Its second ability unlocked in the second phase was ''Nightmare Tear''. It made it fire out five skulls that upon exploding, had a 25% chance to summon a [[Bloated]] and [[Aggro]] [[Unknown Boss]], which also could either be [[Health Regen]] or [[Nimble]], and a 75% chance to summon a [[Bloated]] and [[Aggro]] [[Unknown Small]]. In both Easy and Hard difficulties, while it was suggested it ignored the path, it actually had its own nodal path which was not visible to the player. This path would eventually lead the '''Primordial Drakobloxxer''' to the exit. ==Appearance== '''Primordial Drakobloxxer''' was a large, red-skinned creature with multiple red spikes on its body. Its torso had a darker skin tone than its arms. It had eight arms, each with four claws. It used six of them to support itself while walking and the other two to hold and control a [[God Cube]] shard. Its head was a large mouth with no visible eyes. It walked on fours around the map. After first using its ''Super Dupa Laser'' ability, its skin would become blue and its head would become purple. It would also start walking with its tongue out. It would return to its regular colors when killed. ==Strategy== ===''Easy Difficulty''=== *Multiple high DPS, like the [[Accelerator]], [[Engineer]], [[Pursuit]] or [[Ranger]], can easily kill the '''Primordial Drakobloxxer'''. **Support towers like the [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at boosting your towers. *Selling towers and replacing them near the '''Primordial Drakobloxxer''' is recommended due to its ability to teleport across the map. **High range towers like the [[Ranger]] or [[Mortar]] can be quite useful because of this, as they do not require to be moved. **The [[DJ Booth]] can be used to boost the range of your towers. *Ensure that you have enough other towers to deal with the enemies that spawn along with it. **Multiple Level 4 [[Jester]]s with confusion and poison bombs can greatly help hinder the advancement of the horde while also damaging them to make quick work of them. ===''Hard Difficulty''=== *Due to '''Primordial Drakobloxxer's''' higher health, placing down many high DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Engineer]], [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Pursuit]], [[Ranger]] or [[Turret]] will be able to chip away its health. **The [[Commander]], [[DJ Booth]] or [[Mercenary Base]] can be used to provide buffs to your towers. *Selling towers and replacing them near the '''Primordial Drakobloxxer''' is recommended as '''Primordial Drakobloxxer''' is able to teleport out of the towers' range. **[[Brawler]] is a good pick to fight this boss as you are able to move it using it reposition ability without having to waste the money needed to sell and replace. **The purple aura emitting out of '''Primordial Drakobloxxer''''s body will indicate that it is teleporting. **As an alternative to selling towers, you can use long-ranged towers like the [[Ranger]] as they are more likely to keep '''Primordial Drakobloxxer''' in their range. ***It is recommended to set [[Ranger]]s to ''Strongest'' for this, however one should also be wary of [[Flying]] enemies like the [[Cursed Horror]] that may leak through your defenses if your other towers lack flight detection. *Ensure that you have enough firepower to deal with the enemy hordes that appear after '''Primordial Drakobloxxer''' spawns. **Multiple Level 4 [[Jester]]s with confusion and poison bombs can greatly help hinder the advancement of the horde while also damaging them to make quick work of colspan{{=}}"2" |Death |- |[[File:PrimordialDrakobloxxerDeath.ogg]] |When the '''Primordial Drakobloxxer''' dies |} }}}} ==Trivia== *'''Primordial Drakobloxxer''' was a reference to the Drakobloxxers from the classic Roblox game ''Build To Survive Drakobloxxers!'' by Papasmurf. **Its name suggests it was a more evolved, advanced, and possibly mutated version of it. ***The name may be a reference to the Great Drakobloxxer from ''Combat Initiation'', as it is classified as primordial. *'''Primordial Drakobloxxer's''' internal name was just ''Drakobloxxer''. **Because of this, all the enemies it summoned were called "''Drakobloxxer's _____''" instead of "''Primordial Drakobloxxer's _____''". *'''Primordial Drakobloxxer''' was the largest enemy in the game. *'''Primordial Drakobloxxer''' had the second most abilities in the game, tied with the [[Ducky D00M (D00M's Revenge)|Ducky D00M]] and [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]], who appeared in [[D00M's Revenge]] and [[Krampus Frosthold]] respectively, only behind the [[Frost Spirit]] from the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. *'''Primordial Drakobloxxer''' was the enemy with the longest name in the game, being 22 characters without including spaces. The length has beaten [[Awakened Fallen King]] and [[Korblox Deathwalker (The Hunt)|Korblox Deathwalker]], with each having 18 characters when excluding spaces. *The whispers heard in its theme are actual lyrics. They are these four passages repeated multiple times:[[File:BrimstoneMaledictLyricsProof.png|280px]]
https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/892156782347161690/1340584239883616276 (Tower Defense Simulator Server) **"''I vocare te diaboli - Ustulo omnia - Nova nobis - [[Children of Exo|Children Of Exo]]''" **"''Our World Of Flames''" **"''Hark the Calling of Crows''" **"''Witness pain...''" ==Update History== *'''30 October 2024''' - [[v1.39.0]] **'''Primordial Drakobloxxer''' added. **{{Bug}} Poison and electric defense dropping towers cannot drop its defense. *'''6 November 2024''' - [[v1.40.0]] **'''Primordial Drakobloxxer''' can no longer have its defense decreased. **{{Bugfix}} Poison and electric defense dropping towers now can drop its defense if it is not a [[Boss]] enemy, though the [[Jester]] still cannot drop it. *'''20 November 2024''' - [[v1.42.0]] **'''Primordial Drakobloxxer''' removed. ==Notes== {{Containment|[[Reaper (Hexscape)|Reaper]]|Wave 27|Primordial Drakobloxxer|Wave 30|End|N/A}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]]
